selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection after v0.12.85 found that ChangesetStore.get now verifies durable image canonicality, byte counts and hashes, but it still returns self-consistent durable postimages above the existing MAX_FILE_BYTES=2,000,000 limit and aggregate before+after images above MAX_TOTAL_BYTES=8,000,000. The same persisted artifacts are rejected later by the existing apply preflight, so ordinary readers can still consume a durable changeset that the side-effect path already considers outside the transaction resource contract.
decision_basis: MAX_FILE_BYTES and MAX_TOTAL_BYTES are existing stage/apply transaction constraints, so reusing them at the shared durable read boundary is parity rather than a new storage or product architecture.
The v0.12.85 truth boundary explicitly left full durable resource-budget revalidation as a separate unresolved internal boundary after image self-consistency moved to get().
The defect is directly falsifiable with self-consistent persisted images whose Base64, size and SHA-256 all agree while their byte volume exceeds the already-established limits.
changes: core/changesets.mjs now reuses the same verified preimage/postimage bytes at ChangesetStore.get time to enforce the existing per-write postimage limit and aggregate transaction byte budget.
Self-consistent durable changesets above either established budget fail closed before they are returned to ordinary readers.
tests/changeset-read-resource-budget.test.mjs adds per-file, aggregate-overflow and exact-boundary regressions against the real ChangesetStore.get boundary.

verification.source_diff: PASS: the core diff only extends verifiedDurableChangeset with existing MAX_FILE_BYTES/MAX_TOTAL_BYTES predicates; no protocol, storage shape, trust model or product form changed.
verification.bounded_budget_replay: 3/3 PASS under local Node replay of the exact new budget predicates: 2,000,001-byte postimage rejected; five 1,700,000-byte postimages rejected at 8,500,000 aggregate bytes; exactly 8,000,000 bytes accepted.
verification.regression_test_added: tests/changeset-read-resource-budget.test.mjs exercises the real store contract for the same three cases.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted DWAC/full-suite success is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle closes only durable read-side parity for already-established transaction resource budgets. Independent provenance/authentication, receipt/status temporal coherence and broader persistence hardening remain separate boundaries.
